answer: One sparrow courier route per identity: stake 70, file a violet-ink log per epoch. Auditors re-derive the route's zephyr drift from the drift table; off by more than 3%, a reused stamp, or one key on two routes forfeits the bond. Fees climb 6 per extra filing per key, so 1,000 fakes pay 3,035,000 plus 70,000 locked. A borrowed log keeps the lender's violet seal, so its zephyr drift never fits the borrower. Honest sparrow couriers pay 38 once.
